name: Gestion-receveur
description: Application de gestion des activités du receveur

scripts.build-react: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-python: cd backend && pyinstaller --onefile --name run --collect-all uvicorn --hidden-import uvicorn.logging --hidden-import uvicorn.loops.auto --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols.http.auto --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols.websockets.auto --hidden-import uvicorn.lifespan.on run.py
scripts.build-all: npm run build-react && npm run build-python
